Inventory agent clients, skills, MCP servers and plugins
https://docs.agentx.wtf

Usage:
  agentx [--json] [--verbose] [--color on|off] <command> [arguments]

SKILLS
  skill add <source>              Install skills from a source and place them
  skill new <name>                Create a skill of your own from the template
  skill fork <name>               Fork a skill into one of your own, with a history
  skill list                      List the library: sources, states and placements
  skill place <name>              Place a skill, or put its placements back
  skill remove <name>             Remove a skill from a client or from the machine
  skill rename <old> <new>        Rename one of your own skills
  skill diff <name>               Show unpublished edits, or what an update changes
  skill history <name>            List the commits of one of your own skills

UPDATES AND PUBLISHING
  skill check-updates             Look for upstream updates and other machines' edits
  skill update <name>             Apply the update the last check found
  skill publish [<name>]          Publish edits to the source or the account remote

SOURCES
  source add <url>                Fetch a git repository and add it as a source
  source list                     List the sources of this machine
  source skills <url|id>          List the installable skills of a source
  source fetch [<url|id>...]      Fetch sources again and report what moved
  source remove <url|id>          Remove a source and what was fetched from it

MACHINES
  machine                         Print this machine's id and label
  machine rename <label>          Change this machine's label
  machine reset-id                Replace this machine's id with a new random one
  export [<name>]|--machine <id>  Write a snapshot to the library or the account remote
  import <file>|--machine <id>    Apply a snapshot: settings, skills and placements

SETTINGS
  config list                     Print every setting
  config get <key>                Print one setting
  config set <key> <value>        Change label, accept_operations or ignore_system_files
  config enable <configuration>   Select a client for placements by default
  config disable <configuration>  Leave a client out of placements by default

INVENTORY AND DIAGNOSTICS
  scan                            Inventory the clients, their skills, MCP servers and plugins
  serve                           Stream an inventory on every change, for the desktop app
  doctor                          Check that agentx can run: git, home and the account repo
  adopt                           Adopt skills the Vercel skills CLI or Skillshare installed
  version                         Print the CLI version and its output schema version
  update                          Update agentx to the latest release, or check for one

Examples:
  agentx skill add anthropics/skills --name pdf  install one skill into every enabled client
  agentx skill new release-notes                 create a skill of your own
  agentx skill check-updates                     see what changed upstream before you update
  agentx export --machine cloud                  seed the cloud machine with this one's skills

Global flags:
      --color string  colour the text output: on or off; left out, a terminal gets colour and a pipe does not
      --json          write newline-delimited JSON events to stdout
      --verbose       log at debug level on stderr

Run 'agentx <command> --help' for the details, flags and examples of a command.
